sections.focus: Bare-metal COA concepts, switching circuits, digital logic
Identifying and fixing bugs in faulty C++ and Python code snippets

online_assessment.notes: HFT OAs intentionally disregard standard LeetCode problems. They test systems-level knowledge that most SDE candidates never encounter.

specific_queries: Internal architecture of Ceph distributed storage system
Data consistency protocols in distributed environments
Production orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka architecture
technical_rounds.key_insight: Interview functions as an interrogation on distributed systems. Standard DSA knowledge is insufficient.

technical_rounds.primary_focus: Extreme low-latency programming and network internals
specific_queries: Memory leak prevention in C++ (RAII, smart pointers, valgrind usage)
Lock-free data structures and concurrent programming
CPU cache optimization for latency-sensitive code paths
technical_rounds.key_insight: Candidates who lack top-tier CGPAs but possess god-tier understanding of systems programming are heavily favored over traditional DSA experts.

critical_topics: Switching circuits and digital logic design
C++ memory management (RAII, smart pointers, valgrind)
epoll-based TCP servers and socket programming
preparation_strategy.key_differentiator: Traditional CGPA and LeetCode skills matter less here. Deep systems knowledge (epoll, socket programming, memory management) is the primary differentiator.
